gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC reads dignified and literary, its strokes swelling gently and its terminals pulled well back. Marcellus SC would carry a long passage with a stately, bookish steadiness, while Galaxy's flat marker line stays loud above it.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-ovo: Cosmic and loose, Galaxy draws every letter with one constant, marker-like line. Ovo sits beneath it with shallow ascenders and thins only slightly lighter than its thicks, so the two feel like a shout followed by a measured reply.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-fauna-one: Wide-set, stubborn curves that never quite close: that is Gobold, with its short ascenders and big lowercase body. Fauna One is the one that quietly reads.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-hanuman: Gobold's curves refuse to close, and its letters drift far apart along the line, all drawn with one pen tip. Shrink that heading down and Hanuman's refined texture would win.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla reads refined and authoritative, with a lowercase nearly matching its capitals. Gobold's wire-like line, big and short, is where the heading really counts, gliding across the page with open, stubborn curves.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-slabo-13px: Gobold lays down a commanding, geometric line that glides under the eye like wire, with curves that stay open. And Slabo 13px follows with large open counters in a bookish, dignified voice that would carry a long page without tiring.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-suwannaphum: Gobold spreads monoline letters far apart, its curves left deliberately open and its lowercase body big. But Suwannaphum, with a c as open as a bent paperclip, would look lost if the heading were made small.
gen-dafont-gobold-switzer: Switzer brings Swiss, approachable letterforms with wire-like tubes and c tips that never creep toward touching, set under Gobold's commanding geometry. Its clarity is the standout.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-hedvig-letters-: Wide and muscular, Good Times opens its e with a clear gap and packs its small letters like bundled cable. And Hedvig Letters Serif answers with sturdy lowercase and open-ended curves, feeling authoritative beside such a brash neighbor.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-noto-serif-hent: Refined and traditional, Noto Serif Hentaigana opens its jaws on every curved stroke, while Good Times sits above it as a commanding, geometric heading. Its subtle modulation would keep a long passage graceful.
